caption: The drawing is a monochrome, hand-drawn garden or landscape plan, oriented vertically. It features a rectangular plot divided by a series of straight and curved lines that likely represent pathways or borders. At the lower center, a circular pattern with radiating paths and sections forms a focal point, consisting of a central circle surrounded by eight wedge-shaped segments and four outer rectangular plots. Directly below this circular area are two small rectangles placed side by side, with grouping of small round shapes nearby, possibly representing trees or shrubs. The rectangular sections fill the rest of the plan, with a sinuous, curving path running from bottom center through the length of the plot and splitting some of the rectangles diagonally. In the upper third of the plot, a slightly curved grouping of shaded round forms, mostly on the left, suggest larger trees or a natural cluster, while more scattered small circles, likely representing individual trees or shrubs, appear both inside and around the perimeter of the main rectangular plot. The entire composition is outlined by a single-line rectangular border, and a smaller rectangle projects from the lower left side. A label in the bottom right corner contains handwritten text, and two shapes at the lower edge may represent entryways or architectural features. The drawing is rendered in fine black ink lines on a beige or off-white background.
title: Gardens
